arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and says it can't be fixed (their own online research, not a diagnosis). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent? If so, how do you want the existing machine handled (disconnect, remove, store or dispose, at your cost, not the tenant's)?
options: Consent to the tenant's own machine; we arrange removal/disposal of the old one at your cost (recommended)
Consent, and the old machine is stored/kept for you
Decline and have our contractor inspect and repair or replace the landlord's machine
Arrange your own contractor
arguments.update: No contractor assigned and no visit booked. Nothing is committed until you reply. The tenant's machine would not be on the inventory. Please reply within 3 days.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current machine belongs to the landlord, buying your own needs the landlord's consent, so please hold off buying or connecting one for now. We've asked them, including what should happen to the old machine (that wouldn't be at your cost). We'll note that a machine you buy stays yours and goes with you when you leave. Meanwhile, a photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 29 July.

content.text: Tenant's own appliance needs landlord consent. Ask landlord, tell tenant.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and says it can't be fixed (their own online research, not a diagnosis). They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property and they would take it when they leave. Do you consent? If so, how do you want the existing machine handled (disconnect, remove, store or dispose, at your cost, not the tenant's)?
options: Consent to the tenant's own machine; we arrange removal/disposal of the old one at your cost (recommended)
Consent, and the old machine is stored/kept for you
Decline and have our contractor inspect and repair or replace the landlord's machine
Arrange your own contractor
arguments.update: No contractor assigned and no visit booked. Nothing is committed until you reply. The tenant's machine would not be on the inventory. Please reply within 3 days.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the current machine belongs to the landlord, buying your own needs the landlord's consent, so please hold off buying or connecting one for now. We've asked them, including what should happen to the old machine (that wouldn't be at your cost). We'll note that a machine you buy stays yours and goes with you when you leave. Meanwhile, a photo of the machine and any error code would help. We'll update you by 29 July.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with own; not a repair request. Tenant's machine would stay theirs, not on inventory. Landlord asked re consent and handling of old machine (at landlord cost). No contractor assigned. Fault diagnosis is tenant's own (unverified). Review 2025-07-29.
